messages:
Mia Chen: Quick heads-up — for Hackweek we're piloting a 20-min mini-webinar + prompt-template pack to drive first-5 request activation. thinking through routing and the credit hook.
Jordan Park: love it. are we gating the prompt pack behind a small free-credit claim or just in-email CTA + in-app drawer?
Mia Chen: prefer credit claim (50 tokens) + immediate in-app promptpack. demo shows faster 'aha' when they can run 1-2 requests right away.
Samir Patel: +1. analytics note: if we gate on credit claim we need separate tracking to avoid double-counting webinar RSVPs vs credit redeemers.
Lina Gomez: proposal: two arms
- arm A: email invite -> claim credit -> immediate promptpack + onboarding modal
- arm B: email invite -> open in-app drawer (no credit), soft nudge after 48h
We can BLT test conversion to 5 requests and 1-week retention.
Jordan Park: timeline?
Mia Chen: hackweek demo Mon. soft launch to 2k seed users Thurs. run for 7 days. can we get assets + tracking by Wed morning?
Samir Patel: I'll wire the events. use these Mixpanel events:

```
webinar_hackweek_rsvp
credit_claimed_hackweek
promptpack_installed
first_5_requests
```

Also adding property campaign: "hw-mini-apt-2026" for attribution.
Lina Gomez: I've got the copy draft. short subject lines: "Try Redwood in 5 requests — free credits inside" and "Mini-webinar: ship LLM features in 20 minutes". which resonates more?
Mia Chen: audience split test both. subject A for new signups, B for engaged free users.
Jordan Park: routing — should inbound replies or RSVP signals go to growth inbox or sales? my vote: growth for this pilot, CC sales only if enterprise domain.
Samir Patel: routing rules: if email domain matches enterprise allowlist -> create lead in Salesforce + tag "hw-interest". else -> growth inbox + Slack webhook to #growth-alerts.
ana-bot: scheduled message: calendar invite created for Hackweek demo 2026-04-06 10:00 PDT — attendees: marketing, growth, eng-ml
Lina Gomez: creative ask: need 1 hero image, 3 promo variants for social, and 2 short demo clips (15s). can design deliver by Wed EOD?
Mia Chen: design confirmed. Jenny will own clips.
Jordan Park: do we want a post-launch benchmark narrative for the launch post? recommended sections: "what we tested", "who saw it", "key metrics (first-5, retention, token spend)", "surprises" and "next steps".
Samir Patel: I'll add a lightweight dashboard with per-arm breakdown and latency/cost per request so product can see economics.
Mia Chen: final ask — can ops enable a temporary dedicated routing to the fastest model variant for this cohort? want low latency during demo.
Samir Patel: tagging eng-ml in follow-up. I'll open an ops ticket.
Lina Gomez: ok locking Wed assets, Thurs soft launch, Monday demo. :party-parrot:
Mia Chen: perfect. I'll post the launch checklist in #marketing-prod at 9am Wed. thanks all!
